S1 — BLOCKING: natural-20 item riders are incorrectly widened to all critical hits.
Invariant/authority: each emitted effect must preserve its source trigger, owning bead DESIGN/AC and ADR 0020 source fidelity. Location: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemCombatModifiers.ts:517 and :889; emitted records.json:109032 and :137804; the PR's registry completion assertion is docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json:814.
Concrete scenario: Mace of Smiting and Sword of Life Stealing both emit trigger="critical hit", but the SRD (pp. 229 and 246) requires rolling a 20 on the attack roll. A hit on a paralyzed creature from within 5 feet is a critical hit even with a die result below 20 (condition:paralyzed, SRD p. 358); the emitted trigger grants respectively 2d6/4d6 bludgeoning or 3d6 necrotic extra damage where the item source does not. Expanded critical ranges produce the same disagreement.
Sibling analysis: enumerated all effect triggers containing critical/20. Hammer of Thunderbolts, Sword of Sharpness, Vicious Weapon and Vorpal Sword retain natural-20/attack-roll-20 triggers. Nine Lives Stealer genuinely triggers on a critical hit; Adamantine Armor genuinely normalizes every critical hit. Preserve those distinctions, including construct overrides and excluded target types.
Closure: repair both curated riders to the printed die-result trigger, regenerate, reconcile the semantic-review/registry claim, and add a cheap generalized source-trigger invariant covering the natural-20 siblings while preserving true critical-hit clauses. This is generalized evidence rather than an engine test for each item; it protects the shared misread without demanding capability implementation. Owner: eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5. Repair material: YES (rules semantics); fresh full review of repaired head required.

S2 — BLOCKING: represented clauses still drop or redistribute local eligibility/trigger qualifiers.
Invariant/authority: no added, dropped or altered target, condition, trigger or scope in an emitted effect, owning bead DESIGN/AC and ADR 0020 source fidelity. Primary location: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:127 (records.json:89495). Additional producer locations :212, :261, :282, :579, :717, :936 and magicItemCombatModifiers.ts:927/:939; corresponding emitted effects are identified below. The changed registry reasoning at finding-registry.json:814 incorrectly declares these effects source-agreeing.
Concrete scenarios/membership:
- Arrow-Catching Shield / c2-residual-redirect-ranged-attack: source p. 209 says an attack against a TARGET within 5 feet; effect and operation activation restrict it to a CREATURE. A ranged attack against a nearby object is eligible in the source and excluded by the projection. The PR removes the invented visibility requirement but leaves this target restriction.
- Cloak of Elvenkind / c2-residual-elvenkind-stealth (records.json:94239): source p. 214 grants advantage on Stealth checks MADE TO HIDE; projection requires only hood up. A check to move silently without hiding gains an unsupported advantage.
- Eyes of Minute Seeing / c2-residual-minute-investigation (records.json:100332): source p. 221 requires an Investigation check that RELIES ON SIGHT; projection specifies only the one-foot range. A tactile investigation of a nearby object gets unsupported advantage.
- Gloves of Missile Snaring / c2-residual-snare-missile (records.json:103173): source p. 224 requires a FREE HAND for damage reduction itself. Projection places that restriction only under catchRequirements, and the operation activation has no requirement. A wearer with both hands occupied is granted reduction even when unable to catch.
- Figurine of Wondrous Power / c2-residual-goat-terror-aura (records.json:101300): source p. 222 generates the aura WHILE YOU ARE RIDING the goat. Projection triggers solely on a hostile creature starting within 30 feet. An unridden manifested goat thus emits a fear trigger. Inspected entityGrant and operation context: neither supplies the riding prerequisite.
- Arrow of Slaying / c2-residual-slaying-damage (records.json:89642): source p. 209 triggers when an eligible creature TAKES DAMAGE from the arrow; projection triggers on a HIT. A hit dealing zero damage (for example after damage reduction) incorrectly initiates the extra-damage save. Its operation supplies no takes-damage condition.
- Robe of Eyes / c2-residual-robe-eyes-light-blindness (records.json:123845): source p. 238 distinguishes light CAST ON THE ROBE from daylight CAST WITHIN 5 FEET. Projection joins both spells with both locations. Casting light on a separate object within 5 feet wrongly blinds the wearer.
- Talisman of Pure Good / c2-static-pure-good-spell-attacks (records.json:138528) and Talisman of Ultimate Evil / c2-static-ultimate-evil-spell-attacks (records.json:139062): source p. 247 grants the +2 spell-attack bonus while WEARING OR HOLDING the talisman. Both projections allow only wearing. A properly attuned eligible cleric/paladin holding it loses the printed bonus; inspected curse eligibility leaves do not restore the omitted holding alternative.
Sibling analysis: reviewed all advantage/reaction/triggered-effect and relevant modifier siblings plus their enclosing operations/state. Boots of Elvenkind keeps "moving silently"; Eyes of the Eagle and Robe of Eyes keep "rely on sight"; Cloak of the Bat genuinely grants unrestricted Stealth advantage. Dwarven Plate preserves its forced-ground-movement restriction. Shield of Missile Attraction uses "target", without the creature-only substitution. Both alignment talismans share the holding omission. The paired spell/location case and hit-versus-damage case demonstrate why checking that words/numbers occur somewhere in the description cannot validate their relationships.
Closure: repair these local clauses and every confirmed sibling through curated compiler inputs, keeping qualifiers on the operation/effect stage they govern; regenerate and revise the disposition ledger/registry reasoning. Extend the existing generalized scope assertions with representative source-backed cases covering these qualifier forms and siblings. This is preservation of the meaning of clauses already represented, not a demand to project independent omitted item clauses, all repeat-save branches, or whole-item mechanics. Owner: eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5. Repair material: YES; fresh full review required.

S3 — BLOCKING: spatial projections invent fixed geometry/selection semantics absent from the source.
Invariant/authority: emitted quantities and spatial scope must retain the source relationship, owning bead DESIGN/AC and ADR 0020 source fidelity. Locations: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:1173 (records.json:108227) and magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:970 (records.json:106546).
Concrete scenarios: Javelin of Lightning (source p. 228) creates a five-foot-wide line FROM YOU TO THE TARGET, with the target within 120 feet. Its effect instead has lengthFeet=120. Choose a target 30 feet away with another creature 90 feet along the same direction: the fixed-length projection includes the latter although the printed line ends at the chosen target. Its enclosing operation correctly permits a target within 120 feet and does not transform the fixed length into a target endpoint. Instant Fortress (pp. 226-227) pushes to AN UNOCCUPIED SPACE OUTSIDE BUT NEXT TO the fortress. pushToNearestUnoccupied=true asserts an unprinted nearest-space selection and fails to encode the outside/adjacent constraint. When multiple exterior adjacent spaces exist, the source permits a non-nearest one; the projection rules it out.
Sibling analysis: compared other line/area fields and relocation statements. Staff of Thunder and Lightning actually prints a 120-foot-long line (magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:1408), so its fixed length is correct and must remain. Robe of Stars and Rod of Alertness/earth-related source contexts demonstrate that nearest-space wording is available where printed; it is not printed for Instant Fortress. The source-occurrence screen sees the correct number 120 yet cannot detect its changed role from maximum targeting distance to actual line length.
Closure: restore target-ended geometry for the javelin and source-supported exterior-adjacent displacement for the fortress, without inventing a tie-break policy; regenerate, reconcile the ledger/registry claim, and preserve both through generalized spatial source-agreement assertions with the genuinely fixed-length sibling. No execution engine or universal geometry formalization is required. Owner: eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5. Repair material: YES; fresh full review required.

S4 — BLOCKING: Pipes of the Sewers substitutes an unsupported behavioral exception.
Invariant/authority: an effect cannot replace printed conditions with invented ones; owning bead DESIGN/AC and ADR 0020 source fidelity. Location: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts:478; records.json:114364.
Concrete scenario: source p. 232 says ordinary/giant rats are indifferent and will not attack the attuned bearer unless the bearer THREATENS OR HARMS them. c2-residual-rat-indifference instead says they "begin indifferent unless threatened or commanded otherwise". An order to an ordinary rat, without threatening or harming it, is asserted as an exception that the source does not grant; the source's harm/no-attack boundary is replaced with an initial-disposition claim. This makes model-facing mechanics disagree with the printed clause.
Sibling analysis: inspected the same item's entityGrant: called swarms are initially uncontrolled and become commanded only after the printed Charisma-versus-Wisdom contest. That separate swarm procedure does not authorize substituting a command exception for the ordinary/giant-rat protection. Compared other source-backed controlled entities and command qualifications in the population; their printed command behavior must remain. Competing magic interactions remain DM interpretation, not an unconditional exception invented in this effect.
Closure: restore the printed ordinary/giant-rat protection and its threat/harm exceptions, keep the separately sourced swarm-control procedure distinct, regenerate and reconcile the ledger/registry reasoning. Extend the existing generalized no-added-claims evidence with a source-backed assertion for this substituted exception; no per-swarm engine evidence or universal interaction resolver. Owner: eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5. Repair material: YES; fresh full review required.

S5 — BLOCKING: the authorized mechanical vocabulary screen silently excludes canonical sense values and much of the canonical skill vocabulary.
Invariant/authority: the owning DESIGN requires every enumerated vocabulary value, including senses, carried by an effect to occur in printed source or receive an individually justified source-backed exception; dispatch 19.4.5.1 explicitly repeats sense/skill coverage. A retained proof mechanism must distinguish its claimed bad state from good state (review policy Proof mechanisms are implementation). Locations: packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemEffectSourceAgreement.test.ts:70, :80 and :248.
Concrete reproduction: invoke the actual screenEffect in memory on magic-item:gem-of-seeing / m3-gem-of-seeing-sense-truesight with only sense changed from truesight to blindsight; the item's text has no blindsight, yet violations=[]. Invoke it on magic-item:spell-scroll / scroll-copying-procedure with only skill changed from arcana to survival; the item's text has no survival, yet violations=[]. These are canonical vocabulary substitutions, not free-text semantics. There is no sense entry in VOCABULARY_BY_KEY, and SKILLS lists only eight of the eighteen canonical skills; the includes(lower) condition silently skips recognized-but-unlisted canonical values.
Sibling analysis: queried every existing effect carrying sense/skill: the current population includes truesight/darkvision effects on Gem of Seeing, Goggles of Night, Belt of Dwarvenkind and Robe of Eyes, plus special descriptive sense labels on other items, and skill leaves on Potion of Climbing/Spell Scroll. A fix must check canonical sensory values without blanket-allowlisting special descriptive projections, and must not silently exempt missing canonical skills. Numeric/damage/concentration negative controls currently work; this finding does not require the occurrence screen to prove scope or complete semantics.
Closure: include the authorized canonical sense and skill vocabularies under their actual effect keys, retain short individually justified exceptions/mappings where the source expresses a supported derived label, add representative adversarial substitutions proving both failures are caught, and reconcile test/registry coverage claims. Generalized vocabulary evidence is proportionate to this inexpensive permanent screen; no dedicated test per vocabulary word or new proof framework. Owner: eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5. Repair material: YES (permanent source-fidelity gate coverage); fresh full review required.

NOT A FINDING: requiring whole-item clause completeness, a zero-engine-pending population, capability execution for every effect, or a permanent ledger/test for every effect — no requirement.
NOT A FINDING: occurrence screening cannot establish semantic relationships by itself; the accepted DESIGN explicitly assigns that work to the one-time semantic review plus representative generalized evidence.
NOT A FINDING: carpet threshold multiplier=1 is individually justified by the printed "normal capacity"; the exception is path/value-specific and its continued occurrence is checked.
NOT A FINDING: keeping the registry invariant label while narrowing status/reasoning is consistent with its descriptive identity contract; the blocker is the untrue source-agreement completion assertion, addressed by S1-S4.
NOT A FINDING: the old Sphere of Annihilation audit-bundle deterministic-epic link does not establish an engine obligation for this narrowed row; no requirement to implement Sphere capability in this source-agreement PR.
